hero.subtitle: Join a team of passionate engineers, designers, and thinkers who are redefining how the world clicks. At Dragolink, we don't just route traffic—we build the infrastructure that secures and analyzes billions of digital interactions every day.

perks.title: Work from anywhere
perks.description: We are a remote-first company. Whether you prefer a home office, a co-working space, or a cabin in the woods, you can work from anywhere in the world.

perks.title: Comprehensive Healthcare
perks.description: 100% premium coverage for medical, dental, and vision for you and your dependents, plus mental health and wellness stipends.

perks.title: Unlimited PTO
perks.description: We hire adults and trust them to manage their time. Take the time you need to recharge, travel, and spend time with family. Mandatory 3-week minimum.

perks.title: Home Office Stipend
perks.description: Get a $2,000 stipend to set up your perfect workspace, plus a top-of-the-line MacBook Pro, monitor, and ergonomic chair on your first day.

jobs.title: Senior Distributed Systems Engineer
jobs.description: We are looking for a Senior Distributed Systems Engineer to help scale Dragolink's core link redirection and analytics engine. You will be responsible for designing and implementing high-throughput, low-latency services that handle billions of requests per day.
responsibilities: Design and build scalable, reliable, and performant distributed systems.
Optimize our real-time analytics pipeline processing billions of events.
Mentor junior engineers and contribute to our engineering culture.
requirements: 5+ years of experience in building distributed systems.
Expertise in Java, Go, or Rust.
Deep understanding of databases, caching, and message queues (Redis, Kafka).

jobs.title: Product Marketing Manager
jobs.description: As a Product Marketing Manager, you will be the bridge between our product and our users. You will craft compelling narratives, go-to-market strategies, and marketing campaigns that drive adoption and growth.
responsibilities: Develop and execute go-to-market strategies for new features.
Create product positioning and messaging that resonates with our target audience.
Collaborate with sales and product teams to drive user engagement.
requirements: 3+ years of experience in product marketing for B2B SaaS.
Strong written and verbal communication skills.
Experience with market research and competitive analysis.

jobs.title: Enterprise Account Executive
jobs.description: We are seeking a driven Enterprise Account Executive to expand our presence in the EMEA region. You will be responsible for managing the entire sales cycle, from prospecting to closing six-figure deals.
responsibilities: Manage the full sales cycle for enterprise accounts.
Build and maintain strong relationships with key stakeholders.
Collaborate with solution engineers to deliver compelling product demonstrations.
requirements: 5+ years of experience in enterprise B2B SaaS sales.
Proven track record of consistently exceeding quota.
